text:
maria: FYI — ACME wants us to size commits for a 3-region deployment, plus burst capacity for quarterly batch jobs. they asked for a written plan by EOD Fri.

dan: cool. what are their SLAs? 99th p95?
maria: they want 99th p95 under 120ms for interactive queries and throughput to handle 200 reqs/s sustained, with spikes to 1k reqs/s for 10-15m during sync windows. also nightly batch runs ~400k tokens over 2 hours.
dan: ok that’s mixed workload. shortlist options: (A) Reserved GPUs per region sized for sustained 200 rps + burst credits for spikes. (B) Smaller reserved footprint + autoscale with burst pool and queued backpressure for >SLO.
amit: from infra side: reserved capacity = N gpus x type. for their model (redwood-3b-quant) ~25 rps per A100@batch=16 median token length assumption. rough math: sustained 200 rps -> ~8 GPUs per region. spikes to 1k -> need ~40 GPUs unless we use queuing/burst.
olivia: pricing ask from procurement — they want a commit number and clear overage rules. can we offer burst credits that draw from a burst pool billed at a discounted overage rate?
dan: we can propose commit tiers: commit for baseline (8 GPUs/region) at discounted rate, and a burst credit bucket (e.g., 3M token-burst credits) that can be used across regions; additional burst billed at on-demand premium. include autoscale safety caps.
maria: also security note — they submitted a questionnaire about network isolation and KMS. ACME requires dedicated VPC + CMEK and audit logs. will need private deployment option for their regulated workloads.
amit: private deployment adds infra overhead. we need to factor in a control plane egress and HSM integration time. estimate 4–6 weeks to onboard private. make that optional in POC but include cost impact.
dan: POC plan suggestion: two-week POC. week 1: baseline steady-state tests at 200 rps, verify 99th p95 latency <120ms. week 2: spike tests (1k rps short), nightly batch run. measure cost and tail latencies. include KV/prefix cache warmup in test harness.
maria: timeline looks good. procurement asked if commit can include "burst rollover" — unused burst credits roll into next quarter. ok to offer?
dan: we can do a limited rollover policy (up to 25% carryover) as a negotiation lever. document it in the addendum.
amit: autoscale policy details — set target p95 latency 90ms with continuous batching; scale-up threshold at 70% GPU util, scale-down after 10m of <40% util. also define max burst pool size and per-region caps. include canary rollout for model versions.
olivia: i'll draft the pricing sheet. maria, want me to include a sample commit contract snippet with the rollover clause?
maria: yes please. add a table: baseline GPUs per region, commit price, burst bucket size, burst discount %, overage premium.
maria: quick question for SRE — how do we guarantee cross-region fallback if a region hits capacity?
amit: routing policy: prefer region A, fallback to region B/C if latency delta <100ms and tenant config allows. include automatic model-variant fallback (quantized variant) to keep latency but trade quality. add trace logging for fallbacks.
dan: include PR for the test harness repo and a snippet for the load generator in the RFC: ```bash
# run 200rps steady
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 15m --rps 200 script.js
# spike: ramp to 1000rps for 15m
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 15m --rps 1000 script-spike.js
```
maria: perfect. i'll respond to ACME with this plan and attach the pricing draft + POC checklist. anyone want to add blockers?
dan: engineering risk: private deployment + HSM could push POC timeline. mark as "blocking" until legal signs off.
amit: dependency: need capacity reservation on cloud provider for burst pool to ensure availability during spikes. will submit reservation request but lead time may be 2 weeks.
olivia: procurement also asked about SLA credits if we miss 99th p95 targets during spikes. we should avoid hard SLA on spikes, but offer service credits if sustained underperformance during baseline.
maria: ok, i'll propose a baseline SLA with credits and an advisory note on best-effort for burst windows.
olivia: drafting response now. maria, i'll ping you with the pricing spreadsheet link.
deploy-bot: POC-runner scheduled: 1761510500 — will run nightly batch test at 02:00 UTC on Mon and Wed (auto-notify).
maria: thanks all. I'll send ACME the POC plan + pricing draft by EOD Fri. tagging @dan and @amit for final tech sign-off. :thumbsup:
